output.answer: As of the latest official settlement date of October 30, 2026, Rivian (RIVN) had 173,589,615 shares sold short — up 5.8% (about 9.5 million shares) from the prior report — equal to roughly 12.1% of the public float and about 11.9% of shares outstanding, with days-to-cover of about 5.9 (based on ~29.4 million average daily shares traded). At the stock's report-date price of $12.16, the short position was worth about $2.11 billion. Estimates using different methodologies run slightly higher: ORTEX estimated 17.3% of free float sold short as of October 27, 2026, with ~6.5 days to cover. Short interest has been elevated all year, ranging from about 140 million to 169 million shares in each biweekly FINRA report during 2026.
caveats: Official short interest is reported biweekly by FINRA/Nasdaq with roughly a two-week lag: the latest figure is the 2026-10-30 settlement, so intraday short-selling since then is not reflected.

The percentage varies by denominator and methodology: 12.07% of float (MarketBeat), 11.92% of shares outstanding (AltIndex), 18.41% (ChartExchange's own ratio), and 17.3% of free float as an ORTEX daily estimate — they are the same 173.6M share position measured differently.
Days-to-cover depends on the average-volume window used; a volume spike or further shorting after 10/30/2026 would move it.
